name: Scholara
description: An AI-powered school operating system that unites academics, operations, communication and analytics for students, teachers, parents and school leaders.
problem: A school runs academics, finance, transport, wellbeing and parent communication across spreadsheets, disconnected apps and paper forms. Scholara replaces that patchwork with one system where every role — student, teacher, parent, administrator, principal, counselor, finance staff, librarian and transport manager — works over the same data with its own dashboard, navigation and permissions.

solution: One platform with nine role-specific surfaces over a shared dataset. The AI layer is grounded in the school's own records: the student tutor sees grades and upcoming exams, the teacher copilot drafts lessons, rubrics and feedback, and the principal view summarises the week from real numbers rather than a prompt.
